user.title: Add a bathing spot
user.description: Pick the spot on the map. The nearest sea grid cell with satellite data is looked up automatically.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, for example "Tylösand".
data_description.location: The bathing spot you want the water temperature for.
data_description.max_search_radius: How far from the spot Home Assistant may look for a sea grid cell. Increase it for narrow bays and archipelagos.
data_description.dataset: Automatic picks the highest resolution product that covers the location.

reconfigure.title: Change bathing spot
reconfigure.description: Adjust the location, search radius or data source. The measurement point is looked up again.

data_description.location: The bathing spot you want the water temperature for.
data_description.max_search_radius: How far from the spot Home Assistant may look for a sea grid cell. Increase it for narrow bays and archipelagos.
data_description.dataset: Automatic picks the highest resolution product that covers the location.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Copernicus Marine. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.no_sea_nearby: No satellite sea temperature was found within the search radius. Move the marker closer to open water or increase the search radius.

data_description.update_interval: How often the temperature is fetched. The satellite products are published once a day, so 60 minutes is plenty.

no_recent_data.message: Copernicus Marine has no recent data for the measurement point.

unknown_dataset.message: The data source {dataset} is no longer available. Reconfigure the bathing spot.
